newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fernz buys two chemical companies.
newsitem.headline: Fernz buys two chemical companies.

text.p: New Zealand's Fernz Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it bought 61 percent of Pacific Raw Materials not previously owned and all of Fidene Consolidated (NZ) Ltd.
It paid NZ$3.34 million cash and issued 1.15 million shares for the purchases which it said would add $65 million to the turnover of the company's chemical division on a full-year basis.

The equity component of the purchase price will be held by people who will continue to be involved in the management of the business and have strong trading relationships with the company. Fernz said most of the new business is generated in New Zealand. It is intended to merge the companies with the existing chemical operations of the company and they are forecast to add economic value in the first year.
